subject: Follow-up: stakeholder alignment + 30m product intro windows
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@quantaflow.io>, Sara Nadeem <sara.nadeem@quantaflow.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: stakeholder alignment + 30m product intro windows

Hi Tom / Sara —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for walking us through the ingestion and compliance constraints on your side. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Summary from today: Quantaflow wants predictable per-request latency (<300ms p50 for short prompts), tighter data residency for European workloads later this year, and the ability to run privacy-filtering at the edge before inference.
- Next concrete step: 30-minute product intro focused on fit and ops — we’ll cover an architecture sketch, cost/latency profile for a sample workload, and a short Q&A.

To make scheduling easy, here are three windows (all PT):
1) Tue Nov 25 — 10:00–10:30 PT (best for product + procurement)
2) Wed Nov 26 — 13:00–13:30 PT (ops + infra friendly)
3) Thu Nov 27 — 08:30–09:00 PT (exec-friendly, short overlap)

Please pick the best option and confirm the internal attendees you’ll bring (we suggested owners for each stream below). If none of these work I can send a 2nd set.

Suggested attendee roles from your side:
- Product owner (decision maker)
- Infrastructure/Cloud engineer (ops)
- Security/compliance lead (optional)

From our side I plan to include: Marcus (product + roadmap), Olga (technical lead — serving/runtime), Ben (CS — onboarding & success).

Attaching the discovery notes from today and I’ll follow with a calendar invitation once you confirm a slot.

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: discovery-notes-quantaflow.pdf

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed Nov 26 13:00–13:30 PT works best for our group.

Attendees from Quantaflow:
- Tom Hayes (VP Product) — decision owner
- Sara Nadeem (Cloud Architect) — infra/ops
- Priya Kaur (Security) — will join if the agenda touches PHI/data residency specifics

We’re particularly interested in seeing: a sample latency/cost tradeoff for a 2k-token prompt, how prefix caching could work for our use case, and the Private/VPC deployment brief.

If you can include any short pre-read or a one-pager on the Private option that would be great — my security lead may skim ahead.

Tom

Perfect — I’ve locked Wed Nov 26 13:00–13:30 PT for the intro and sent an invite (redwood-demo-invite.ics).

Agenda (30m):
- 0–6m: quick intros & outcomes
- 6–16m: demo + architecture sketch (Olga) — focus on latency path and caching
- 16–24m: deployment options & cost profile (Marcus)
- 24–30m: Q&A and next steps (Ben)

I attached the discovery notes and a one-page Private deployment brief to this message. If Priya wants more detail we can surface the VPC/KMS flow and redact any customer-specific numbers prior to sharing.

Olga / Ben — can you both join the call? Ben — please be prepared to outline the typical onboarding timeline and a checklist for node provisioning. Olga — can you bring the short demo that highlights KV/prefix caching behavior for repeated queries?

Tom / Sara — I’ll include a short pre-read link in the invite (HubSpot + Drive). Looking forward to it.

Thanks — Marcus

--
